title: Run a Genesis builder call off the Body's turn (S38-A follow-up)
problem: Genesis._builder_route called builder.build inside MissionEngine._step, under the Body's turn lock. A Claude Code build may take up to its 300 s timeout per attempt, two attempts per deficit. While it ran no other mission was stepped, the inbox was not read and the heartbeat stopped. #273 moved worker.commission's adapter off the turn; builder calls were named there as unconverted. Separately, Genesis set the per-call ceiling on the one shared builder object (self.builder.max_budget_usd), which is safe only while calls are serial.
founder_intent_refs: Founder decision in this session, 2026-11-21, recorded on #96 comment 7068061767: own the Genesis builder-call change and WU-03
directive 2026-10-28 section 38 (S38-A): one long call must not freeze every other mission
acceptance H.G7: a build the body died inside is charged at its reserved ceiling
baseline: #196 12119590: builder.build inline in the turn; the per-call ceiling written onto the shared builder

alternatives.name: Run the whole mission step on a dispatch thread (Background.dispatch)
alternatives.description: Treat _step as the act and wrap builder.build like a worker adapter.
disadvantages: A step can also dispatch a worker: nested dispatches share one mission key in Background.running
Every step pays a thread; verification and attach would run on a second thread
alternatives.revival_evidence: A second kind of long call inside a step that needs the turn's state while it runs

alternatives.name: Only the builder call leaves the turn; the next step takes its result (OffTurnBuilds)
alternatives.description: Record the reservation on the turn, run builder.build on a thread that touches no shared state, end the step, and take the result on the mission's next step, which resumes the same open deficit.
advantages: The build thread never enters the journal, Gate, registry or book
Reuses the restart path that already exists (an open deficit is resumed; an unsettled build is charged at its reservation)
disadvantages: The step's remaining work runs one turn later
A result that is never taken stays charged at its reservation

alternatives.name: Give every builder a stop_check and keep it inline
alternatives.description: Make STOP interrupt the call, but leave it on the turn.
disadvantages: Other missions still freeze for the whole call; only STOP improves
alternatives.revival_evidence: None; does not produce the effect

alternatives.name: Pass the ceiling as a build() argument
alternatives.description: Change the builder interface instead of copying the builder per call.
disadvantages: Changes every builder and test double's signature
alternatives.revival_evidence: A builder that cannot be shallow-copied

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Each real build freezes the whole Body for up to 300 s per attempt; a second mission's build would also rewrite the first's ceiling once builds ran at once.
advantages: No change to the Genesis loop
disadvantages: Heartbeat silence reads as a dead body to the supervisor

roles.position: The founder asked for exactly this split: only builder.build leaves the turn; reservation, journal, verification and attach stay serialized.
material_concerns: No authority changes: the same signed budget, cone and attach rules apply on the step that takes the result

roles.position: The build thread is pure: request in, candidate out. The step that takes it is an ordinary turn, so nothing new runs concurrently with the journal.
material_concerns: BuildHandedOff is a BaseException so no except Exception on the step's path contains it; MissionEngine catches it

roles.position: An independent review found two more (W4, W5), both fixed and tested. Attacked: a result taken after the founder ended the mission; two missions sharing one builder object; a finished result blocked by its own reservation; a need served by another mission's build.
material_concerns: Each attack is a test; the reservation-blocks-itself and served-meanwhile defects were found and fixed while writing them

roles.position: STOP no longer waits up to 300 s for a build; body.stopped names the builds left unfinished, and the restart charges them until reconciled.
material_concerns: A real Claude Code subprocess keeps running until the process exits; its spend is bounded by the reserved ceiling

roles.position: Spend is never under-booked: an untaken call stays charged at its ceiling (H.G7); a taken or served one settles at its reported cost.
material_concerns: Overcharge, not undercharge, is the failure direction

evidence.finding: On #196 12119590 the first 5 tests fail (163 s, each waiting out its 30 s timeout); with the change all 5 pass in about 9 s

evidence.claim: Mission B closes while A's builder is held
evidence.finding: B is achieved while A's call has neither been released nor returned; the heartbeat shows A WORKING with action genesis.build:markdown.unchecked_count; A closes after release with one build, taken once

evidence.claim: Each mission builds under its own signed ceiling
evidence.finding: Two missions signed at 0.3 and 0.7 build at once; the calls see 0.3 and 0.7, the shared builder keeps 1.0, and each deficit settles at its reported cost

counterevidence.claim: A Body STOP used to wait for the build
counterevidence.finding: Now it does not; the build's result is lost and charged at its ceiling. This is the existing semantics of a body killed inside the call, now also reached by STOP

pass_1.intended_outcome: A Genesis build no longer freezes the Body, and builds in flight together each stay inside their own mission's signed limit.

advantages.statement: Other missions, the inbox and the heartbeat keep turning during a build
advantages.amplified_value: The last measured whole-body freeze from a single call is gone
Concurrent builds cannot borrow each other's signed budget

disadvantages.statement: An untaken result stays charged at its ceiling
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Served-meanwhile results are settled at their reported cost; only abandoned or stopped ones keep the reservation
body.stopped names it; the restart charges and resumes

disadvantages.statement: A late result could arrive after the mission's authority changed
disadvantages.redesigned_response: It is only taken on an ordinary step, which checks the mission's current state, cone and attach rules

pass_1.selected_design: OffTurnBuilds: only builder.build off the turn; take the result on the next step

comparisons.baseline: Inline builder call under the turn lock
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Run the whole step on a dispatch thread
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Off only in Body.run's main loop; engine.builds = None restores inline builds

rejected_alternatives.name: Whole step on a dispatch thread
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Nested worker dispatch shares one mission key
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A long call that needs the turn's state while it runs

rejected_alternatives.name: Ceiling as a build() argument
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A builder that cannot be copied

pass_2.attack_summary: Re-attacked the selected design for lost spend, double builds, stale authority and process lifetime.

new_weaknesses.statement: A finished result's own reservation made the budget look spent, so it was never taken
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: A finished call counts like an unjudged paid candidate; fixed and pinned by the liveness test

new_weaknesses.statement: When another mission's build serves the need first, the second call would stay charged at its ceiling forever
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: settle_served_builds records its reported cost at the start of the mission's next step

new_weaknesses.statement: copy.copy of a builder that keeps per-instance counters would lose them
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Only used off the turn; the shipped builders keep no counters; recorded as a residual risk

new_weaknesses.statement: Independent review (#336 comment 7068679898): the production ModelBuilder's router record callback (greg.model_keys.attach) wrote model.route to the journal from the build thread, off the turn
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Each off-turn call gets a private router whose record only buffers; the step that takes the result replays the events into the shared router on the turn (journal write and key bench as inline). Pinned by a ModelBuilder test that fails on df2455ea

new_weaknesses.statement: Independent review: builder copies shared one router, so a RouteError could book another mission's router.last cost
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The private router has its own health, routes and last; the shared router's last stays None while calls are in flight, and each failure books its own billed cost (tested)

residual_risks.risk: A real coding-agent subprocess outlives a STOP until the process exits
residual_risks.mitigation: Bounded by its reserved ceiling and by the builder's own timeout
residual_risks.review_trigger: A builder with a stop hook

residual_risks.risk: A future builder keeps per-call state on the instance
residual_risks.mitigation: Copy per call; the builder interface stays request in, candidate out

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Served results are settled; others keep the safe overcharge

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A builder that can be stopped

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Tested: an ended mission's late result is never taken
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any new path that takes a result outside a step

pass_2.final_design: greg/background.OffTurnBuilds plus BuildHandedOff; Genesis records the reservation, hands off the call with a per-call builder copy, and takes or settles the result on the mission's next step; the Body enables it only in its main loop.

migration_plan: None: no record schema or stored state changes; body.stopped gains an optional builds_unfinished field.

steps: Revert the commit; Body.run then builds inline again

kill_criteria: Any build charged below its reported cost
A result attached to a mission the founder ended
decision_owner: the #196 integrator, on this draft's evidence; merge remains the founder's
review_trigger: A builder that supports stop, or a second kind of long call inside a mission step
